summary: Seek the latest transport observation by peer and originating writer

replay.detail: Claim contents and canonical ordering are unchanged.

schema.detail: Store opening idempotently creates a partial claims index on subject, origin and numeric-text acceptance time for transport.observed. Existing stores build the index once; no backfill table or schema-version change is needed.

rules.detail: Transport status, refresh windows and canonical timestamp ties retain their existing semantics.

compatibility.detail: No wire or persisted claim changes. Older binaries can read the same store and ignore the additive index.

downtime.detail: The first open builds the index over existing claims before normal service startup.

recovery.detail: Binary rollback does not require undoing the index.
